job.question: Which pension system's investment consultant RFP requires respondents to have at least five defined benefit pension plan clients, two of which are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each?
job.expected_facts: Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), in its 2021 investment consultant services RFP (Appendix E, Minimum Qualifications Certification).
job.acceptance: OCERS/Orange County Employees Retirement System suffices. Appendix designation, year and restatement of qualification are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund sample RFP, not an OCERS RFP. Its qualification specifies at least one public pension plan client with $10 billion in assets, not five defined benefit clients including two public plans with at least $15 billion each.
quotes: The Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) is requesting proposals from investment consulting firms

Demonstrated experience in providing discretionary or non-discretionary investment advisory services to large public pension plan clients, at least one of which must have total plan assets of $10 billion.
